title: OneVisit · Registry office assistant
welcome: Hi! I help you prepare your appointment at the City of Milan registry office, so you can get everything done on the first visit. Tell me what you need to do, in your own language if you like.
ai_disclosure: You are talking to an artificial intelligence. Information comes from the official sources it cites; the final decision is always made by the officer at the desk. Do not write your name, tax code, address or document numbers.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly or check the official City website.
error_link: This link is not valid or has expired.
error_db: This feature is not available right now.
contact_title: Would you like a reminder before your appointment?
contact_choice: How would you like to be contacted?
contact_none: No contact: I'll download a calendar reminder
consent_followup: One question after the appointment about how it went
consent_correction: A notice if the information I gave you is corrected
invalid_email: The email address does not look right.
invalid_phone: The phone number does not look right.
missing_contact: Please enter at least one contact.
contact_saved_email: Done. We sent you a confirmation email: reminders start only after you confirm the address.
contact_saved_sms: Done. You will receive SMS messages according to the consents you gave.
contact_none_done: No contact saved. You can download a reminder for your calendar.
checklist_intro: Tick the documents you already have. The official name is in Italian, as the desk officer will read it.
checklist_empty: There are no verified requirements to show for this case yet. Please check the official City website.
checklist_lead_time: Estimated time to get it: {days} days.
checklist_todo: Get it before the appointment following the cited source.
checklist_all_present: According to the cited sources, all the required documents are present.
checklist_human: The final decision is made by the officer at the desk.
outcome_pick: What was missing? Pick from the list
outcome_text: Or describe it briefly (no personal data)
outcome_closed: Was the procedure completed in that visit?
outcome_thanks: Thank you! Your answer helps us improve the information for everyone.
consents_intro: You can revoke all consents or delete your contact at any time.
consents_revoked: Consents revoked. You will not receive any more messages.
